messages:
maria (People Ops): Sharing a short template we're calling the Goal Evidence Matrix (GEM). It's a lightweight ledger to attach concrete artifacts to each KR. Please try it this quarter and flag any gaps. Link (view): https://go.redwood/gem-pilot.
kevin (Eng): Looks good. Is GEM a replacement for existing KR descriptions or an adjunct?
sophie (Product): Adjunct. KR stays as the outcome; GEM is the artifacts/evidence log you accumulate. Useful for reviews and retrospective writeups.
maria (People Ops): Exactly. Guidance in doc: add 1-3 evidence rows per KR; each row should include: short description, date, owner, signal source (synthetic/user/experiment), link to raw artifact (dashboard, PR, runbook), and reviewer note.
jamal (Manager): Example for a multi-team KR? we often cite cross-team deliverables.
maria (People Ops): Example included under "Cross-team sample". Quick snippet here:
```
KR: Improve hosted API p95 latency by 25%
Evidence A: Batching rollout -> p95 reduced from 560ms to 420ms (prod metric, 2026-02-18)
Signal: production telemetry
Artifact: metrics.redwood.com/dashboards/p95-batching
Owner: eng-runtime@redwood
Reviewer note: clear reduction; include experiment config next time
```
lina (Data): Would be helpful to mark evidence type: metric, qualitative, incident, customer-quote. Makes auto-summary easier.
maria (People Ops): Added an "evidence type" column in v1.1.
kevin (Eng): Also can we have a short method note field so reviewers know if metric is synthetic (locally rerun) vs live traffic? saves follow-ups.
maria (People Ops): Yup added "methodology".
sophie (Product): For PMs, we added a small "customer impact" row (one sentence + link to ticket/CS note).
jamal (Manager): Any suggested manager phrasing for feedback on evidence quality? want consistent micro-feedback styles across org.
maria (People Ops): Doc includes manager micro-phrases under "Review Guidance":
- Positive: "This evidence is time-stamped and links to dashboards; please add the experiment ID for reproducibility."
- Ask for clarity: "Can you add a short note on measurement method and sampling window?"
- Encourage stretch: "Strong signal; consider adding cross-customer usage numbers to show scale."
kevin (Eng): What's the cadence? keep updating live or only at mid/end-cycle?
hr-bot: Reminder: Mid-cycle check-ins open 2026-03-30. People Ops recommends ongoing updates; we'll snapshot for check-ins.
sophie (Product): ongoing updates preferred. small weekly entries make review lightweight.
jamal (Manager): I'll ask my directs to add at least one GEM row per KR by next Wednesday EOD.
maria (People Ops): Thanks! We also included a condensed "Quick GEM" one-pager for teams that want minimal overhead (3 rows max). If you'd like a 15-min walkthrough, ping me and I'll hop on a team sync. :thumbsup:
